description: Minimum slab thickness, subbase, joint spacing, joint depth and reinforcing notes for a walk, patio, driveway, parking lot or truck pad, from published ready-mix concrete association guidance. Every parameter is optional and has a default. Guidance only, not a slab design. Loads, soil, frost, drainage, concrete mix and the municipal or project specification decide the final thickness and reinforcing, and an engineer designs parking lots, truck pads and anything carrying heavy equipment.

length.description: Slab length. Unit: m or ft.

subgrade.description: Firm, or unstable, organic or uncompacted material under the slab.

thickness.description: Slab thickness. Leave out to use the minimum for the use. Parking lots and truck pads have no minimum here; enter the thickness your engineer designs. Unit: mm.

units.description: Units for slab length and width.

use.description: walk_patio, driveway_car (passenger vehicles), driveway_heavy (delivery vehicles or other heavy loads), parking_lot or truck_pad.

width.description: Slab width. Unit: m or ft.

name: concrete_slab_thickness_and_reinforcing_guide
title: Concrete Slab Thickness, Joints and Reinforcing Guide
